title: The First Token Knows: Single-Decode Confidence for Hallucination Detection
abstract: arXiv:2605.05166v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Sampling-based uncertainty methods detect hallucinations by generating multiple answers and measuring agreement, often with additional semantic clustering. We study whether uncertainty is already visible in the first content-bearing answer token of a single greedy decode. We define first-token confidence, phi_first, as one minus the normalized entropy of the top-K first-token distribution. Across PopQA and TriviaQA with three 7-8B instruction-tuned models, phi_first matches or modestly exceeds semantic self-consistency while requiring only one decode instead of one greedy decode plus ten sampled generations and NLI clustering. A subsumption analysis shows that phi_first is moderately to strongly correlated with semantic agreement, and combining both signals yields only small additional AUROC gains. translated_title: 首个词元即知晓：用于幻觉检测的单次解码置信度
translated_abstract: 基于采样的不确定性方法通过生成多个答案并衡量其一致性来检测幻觉，通常还需额外的语义聚类步骤。我们研究不确定性是否已经在单次贪心解码产生的首个承载内容的答案词元中显现。我们定义首个词元置信度 phi_first 为 1 减去 top-K 首词元分布的归一化熵。在 PopQA 和 TriviaQA 数据集及三个 7-8B 指令微调模型上的实验表明，phi_first 能够匹配甚至略微超越语义自一致性方法的表现，而仅需一次解码，无需一次贪心解码外加十次采样生成以及 NLI 语义聚类。包含性分析显示，phi_first 与语义一致性呈中等到强相关，将两种信号结合仅带来很小的额外 AUROC 提升。我们将 phi_first 定位为一种面向实际部署的、低成本的事实性问答不确定性估计基线方法，同时指出了其局限性。
tldr: 该论文提出首个词元置信度 phi_first，仅需单次贪心解码即可从 top-K 首词元分布中估计不确定性，其幻觉检测效果媲美甚至略超需要十次采样生成加 NLI 语义聚类的语义自一致性方法，大幅降低计算成本。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces first-token confidence (phi_first), which estimates uncertainty from the top-K first-token distribution of a single greedy decode, matching or modestly exceeding semantic self-consistency for hallucination detection while avoiding ten sampled generations and NLI clustering.
